definitions.journey_grain: one unique departureDate + trainNumber, using first commercial departure and last commercial arrival at Finnish passengerTraffic=true stations
definitions.on_time: final actual arrival is no more than the selected number of whole minutes after schedule; early arrivals count as on time
definitions.cancelled: Digitraffic whole-train cancelled flag; cancelled commercial rows are also counted separately as partial cancellations
definitions.missing_actuals: not imputed and excluded from punctuality denominators
definitions.time_zone: Digitraffic UTC converted with Europe/Helsinki IANA rules for local month, weekday and hour
